title: Runtime Safety Filtering for Learned Small UAS Separation Policies under GNSS Degradation
abstract: arXiv:2607.10014v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Learning-based separation assurance for small Unmanned Aircraft Systems (sUAS) achieves near-zero collision rates in simulation, but assumes accurate position and velocity information from Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS). This assumption fails in urban environments, where multipath propagation, signal blockage, and intentional interference degrade navigation integrity. This raises a fundamental architectural question for deploying learned separation policies under GNSS degradation: should runtime safety mechanisms filter the policy's actions or its observations? This work evaluates both approaches for multi-agent sUAS separation under adversarial GNSS degradation. translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.10014v2 公告类型： replace-cross。摘要：基于学习的小型无人机系统（sUAS）间隔保持方法在仿真中可实现接近于零的碰撞率，但其依赖于来自全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）的精确位置和速度信息。这一假设在城市环境中会失效，因为多径传播、信号遮挡以及有意干扰会降低导航完整性。这为在GNSS退化条件下部署学习型间隔保持策略提出了一个根本性的架构问题：运行时安全机制应当过滤策略的动作，还是过滤其观测？本工作针对对抗性GNSS退化下的多智能体小型无人机间隔保持问题，对这两种方法进行了评估。两种架构均首先估计与有界观测不确定性相一致的最坏情况交通状态，随后产生分歧：动作过滤通过在最坏情况状态下评估的离散时间控制障碍函数来约束策略输出，而观测过滤……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文针对GNSS退化环境下学习型小型无人机间隔保持策略的部署问题，研究了运行时安全机制应过滤策略动作还是过滤观测这一根本性架构问题，并基于最坏情况状态估计对两种方案进行了评估与比较。
en_tdlr: This paper addresses the fundamental architectural question of whether runtime safety mechanisms should filter a learned sUAS separation policy's actions or its observations under GNSS degradation, evaluating both approaches based on worst-case state estimation.
